phases.publicApiBoundary: Source/disk-only native history restores the applied suffix after a matching saved checkpoint. Editor artifacts use the public recovered-action commands because native WorkspaceEdit history shares the source URI. Existing native redo branches remain validated data; ordinary text history and a second CustomEditor view have separate boundaries.

restoredHistory.limitation: Only applied operations after the saved checkpoint enter native history; the earlier prefix and existing redo branch remain recovery data.
